---
title: "Runtime and Ratings" 
---

This plot shows the relationship between the Runtime and the viewer's ratings of the 104 films @fig-runtime-rating

```{python}
#| echo: true
#| label: fig-runtime-rating
#| fig-cap: "Film runtimes and IMDb ratings."

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")

plt.scatter(films["runtime_min"], films["imdb_rating"])
plt.xlabel("Runtime (minutes)")
plt.ylabel("IMDb rating (0–10)")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.show()
```

## Table of Mean rating by decade

```{python}
#| echo: true

films["decade"] = films["year"] // 10 * 10
films.groupby("decade")["imdb_rating"].mean().round(2)
```
